answer: Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 13 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. Histories are stored in atlas, checked in oasis, and mirror makes public each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases since the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. A farm of 1768 identities would post 1069 proofs and burn roughly 39 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
